title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 5) Notification 2005

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 5) Notification 2005.

2. There shall be exempt from tax —
(a)interest payable by Jembawati Maritime Pte. Ltd. from 6th September 2004 to 6th September 2011 (both dates inclusive) to Fortis Bank S.A./N.V., Singapore Branch under the Loan Agreement dated 23rd August 2004 in respect of the vessel “Jembawati”; and
(b)fees payable by Jembawati Maritime Pte. Ltd. to Fortis Bank S.A./N.V., Singapore Branch under the Loan Agreement referred to in sub-paragraph (a).
